	has_variable = ruling_party
	OR = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 5 } check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 } }
}

COLDWAR_EB_is_member = {
	IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
	NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = COLDWAR_EB_rule option = OFF } }
	OR = { COLDWAR_EB_communist_rules = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_junta }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_democratised }
}

COLDWAR_EB_moscow_active = {
	country_exists = SOV
	SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member }
}

COLDWAR_EB_moscow_lid = {
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member
	NOT = { original_tag = SOV }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_let_go }
	COLDWAR_EB_moscow_active = yes
	OR = {
		is_subject_of = SOV
		check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }

}

COLDWAR_EB_is_ssr = {
	has_autonomy_state = autonomy_soviet_republic_1985
}

COLDWAR_EB_active = {
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_frozen }
}

COLDWAR_EB_safe_crackdown = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_fa_active
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_hard_days > 89 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_EB_ai_intervenes = {
	# THIS = Soviet Union, FROM = troubled member
	check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_EB_doctrine = 1 }
	FROM = {
		OR = {
			COLDWAR_EB_is_ssr = yes
			capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_EB_bond_ok = {
	# THIS = issuer, ROOT = buyer: a bond across the blocs needs an interest that covers the risk of the Cold War
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_bond_min_tt
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_alignment }
			NOT = { ROOT = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_alignment } }
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 }
			check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 }
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment }
			NOT = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier }
			check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 1 }
			AND = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 2 } check_variable = { ROOT.bond_interest > 0.499 } }
			AND = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 3 } check_variable = { ROOT.bond_interest > 0.999 } }
			AND = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 4 } check_variable = { ROOT.bond_interest > 1.999 } }
			AND = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 5 } check_variable = { ROOT.bond_interest > 2.999 } }
		}
	}
}
